description: Travel Photo File Organization MVP - reset Pindrop around organizing travel photo files into a reviewable date/place structure, exporting a byte-preserving ZIP, and keeping maps as supporting previews.

userStories.title: Align docs and product copy with file organization
userStories.description: As a developer, I want docs and visible copy to describe Pindrop as a travel photo file organizer so that future work does not drift back to map-first behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: README describes the primary outcome as organized photo files or ZIP export
REQUIREMENTS describes maps as a supporting preview, not the primary product goal
Existing Korea-map PRD language is marked superseded or moved to supporting context
User-facing hero or upload copy emphasizes photo file organization before map preview
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed: README and REQUIREMENTS now define Pindrop as a travel photo file organizer with ZIP export as the primary outcome, Korea-map PRDs are marked superseded, and the visible hero/upload copy emphasizes importing and organizing photos before map preview. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and a Playwright DOM check on http://127.0.0.1:5000/.

userStories.title: Add organization metadata defaults
userStories.description: As a developer, I want each photo record to have organization metadata so that the app can build a deterministic preview and export.
acceptanceCriteria: Photo normalization stores original filename, stored filename, MIME type, file size, and import timestamp when available
Photo normalization stores candidate capture date, candidate place, confidence, and reason text
Old pin/photo records without organization fields load without crashing
New records preserve organization fields when saved and reloaded
Backend tests cover old records and new organization metadata
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: backend normalization now adds sourcePhoto and organization metadata, upload responses include source file metadata, GPS-backed browser records persist the metadata, old records are normalized safely, JSON export carries the fields, and backend/e2e tests cover old and new metadata. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Persist GPS-missing photos as source photos
userStories.description: As a user, I want GPS-missing photos to enter the organization workflow so that they are not silently dropped from file organization.
acceptanceCriteria: GPS-missing supported images are uploaded or retained as source photos
GPS-missing photos persist with regionScope `unknown` and organization status requiring inference or fallback
GPS-missing photos appear after page reload
Unsupported files still show an error and are excluded
Browser test covers one GPS-missing image entering the workflow
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: GPS-missing supported images now upload as source photos, persist with regionScope unknown and organization.status needs_inference, restore after reload/session restore with GPS 없음 status, and remain excluded from map point counts. Unsupported and oversized files still error out. Verified with browser e2e coverage plus npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Resolve capture date with fallbacks
userStories.description: As a user, I want photos grouped by the best available date so that the organized ZIP is easy to browse chronologically.
acceptanceCriteria: Date resolver uses EXIF DateTimeOriginal first
Date resolver uses file modified date when EXIF date is unavailable
Date resolver returns `Unknown Date` when no reliable date exists
Resolved date folder names use `YYYY-MM-DD` for known dates
Tests cover EXIF date, modified date, invalid date, and unknown date fallback
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: frontend metadata extraction now resolves capture dates with EXIF DateTimeOriginal/DateTime first, file lastModified second, and Unknown Date fallback. Organization candidate dates use YYYY-MM-DD for known dates. Added tests/unit/exif.cjs for EXIF, modified date, invalid EXIF, and unknown fallback, and updated browser e2e expectations. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Add safe folder and filename helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want deterministic path helpers so that generated organization paths are safe on Windows and never overwrite files.
acceptanceCriteria: Path helper removes or replaces Windows-invalid characters in folder names and filenames
Path helper trims empty names and uses safe fallback values
Duplicate filenames in the same output folder receive deterministic suffixes
Path helper prevents `..` path traversal segments
Tests cover unsafe characters, empty names, duplicate names, and traversal input
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: added backend safe path helpers for Windows-safe folder segments and filenames, Unknown Date/Unknown Location fallback folders, traversal-safe path segments, deterministic duplicate suffixes per output folder, and output path generation. Added backend tests for unsafe characters, empty names, traversal input, duplicate filenames, and fallback paths. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Resolve place for GPS-backed photos
userStories.description: As a user, I want GPS-backed photos grouped by place so that the output folders match where the trip happened.
acceptanceCriteria: GPS-backed photos use the existing reverse geocode flow to propose a place
Resolved place names are passed through the safe folder helper
Reverse geocode failure falls back to `Unknown Location` or a coordinate-based label
Domestic/international scope remains metadata and does not replace the date/place folder rule
Tests cover reverse geocode success and failure
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: GPS-backed photos continue to use the existing reverse geocode flow, resolved places are safe-foldered through output_path_for_pin, reverse geocode failure keeps a coordinate fallback that can be grouped, and regionScope remains metadata rather than part of the date/place folder rule. Added backend tests for success-safe-folder and failure-coordinate grouping. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Add VLM place inference endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want GPS-missing photos analyzed with visual clues so that stripped or screenshot images can still be organized.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend endpoint accepts a stored filename and returns inferred place, confidence, and reason
Inference prompt asks for landmarks, signs, venue names, broad scene context, and uncertainty
Filename and source folder name can be passed as weak text clues
Missing VLM model returns a graceful unavailable response instead of failing the workflow
Backend tests cover VLM success and VLM unavailable responses with mocks
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: added POST /infer-place for stored GPS-missing photos. It checks llama3.2-vision availability, returns a graceful available:false response when the model is missing, sends the image plus weak filename/source-folder clues when available, asks for landmarks/signs/venue names/broad scene context/uncertainty, and parses structured place/confidence/reason JSON. Added backend tests for VLM success and unavailable responses. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Connect GPS-missing photos to inference fallback
userStories.description: As a user, I want GPS-missing photos to get a best-effort place proposal so that they can be included in organized output.
acceptanceCriteria: GPS-missing browser flow calls the VLM inference endpoint when a stored file is available
Successful inference updates candidate place, confidence, and reason
Low-confidence or unavailable inference falls back to `Unknown Location`
Missing VLM model does not block preview generation or ZIP export
Browser test covers inference success and unavailable fallback
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: GPS-missing browser flow now calls /infer-place when a stored upload exists. Successful medium/high inference updates place, organization.candidatePlace, confidence, reason, and status; unavailable or low-confidence inference falls back to Unknown Location without blocking the workflow. Browser e2e covers inference success, unavailable fallback, low-confidence fallback, and restore behavior. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Generate organization preview paths
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to propose clear output paths so that I can understand the final ZIP before downloading it.
acceptanceCriteria: Default output path format is `YYYY-MM-DD_<Place>/<filename>`
`Unknown Date` and `Unknown Location` are used when date or place cannot be resolved
Output paths use safe folder and filename helpers
Duplicate output paths are made unique without overwriting
Tests cover known date/place, unknown date, unknown place, and duplicates
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: added GET /organization/preview to generate output paths from saved photos using YYYY-MM-DD_<Place>/<filename>, Unknown Date/Unknown Location fallbacks, safe folder/filename helpers, and deterministic duplicate suffixes. Added backend tests for known date/place, unknown fallbacks, and duplicate paths. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Persist organization preview state
userStories.description: As a user, I want the organization preview to survive page reloads so that I do not lose the proposed structure while reviewing photos.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview output path, proposed date, proposed place, confidence, and reason persist in the app session storage format
Reloading the page restores preview metadata for each photo
Existing pin/photo persistence remains backward compatible
Backend tests or browser tests cover save and reload of preview metadata
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: session persistence now stores organization.outputPath alongside candidateCaptureDate, candidatePlace, confidence, reason, and status. load_pins/save_pins attach deterministic output paths for every saved photo while preserving backward compatibility for older records. Added backend test proving preview metadata is written to pins.json and restored through GET /pins. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Show organization preview tree
userStories.description: As a user, I want to review the proposed folder and file structure before export so that I can catch mistakes.
acceptanceCriteria: UI shows grouped organization preview by date and place
Each photo row shows thumbnail, original filename, proposed folder, and proposed filename
Preview updates when new photos are added
Empty state explains that photos must be imported before preview appears
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: added sidebar organization preview UI grouped by proposed folder, with each row showing thumbnail, original filename, and proposed filename. The preview renders an import empty state, updates after restore/new uploads/place inference/deletion, and keeps map preview secondary. Browser e2e covers grouped preview, row fields, empty state, and update after a GPS-missing photo; local Playwright check verified the section at http://127.0.0.1:5000/. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, and npm run test:demo.

userStories.title: Show organization decision reasons
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see why each photo was placed in a folder so that I can trust or correct the proposed organization.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview row shows decision source: GPS, VLM, filename/folder clue, or fallback
Preview row shows confidence value or confidence bucket when available
Fallback and low-confidence decisions are visually distinct
Reason text is visible without opening the map
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: organization preview rows now show decision source, confidence bucket, and visible reason text without opening the map. GPS, VLM, filename/folder, fallback, and low-confidence decisions get distinct labels, with fallback/low-confidence styling visually distinct. Browser e2e covers GPS source, VLM medium, fallback unavailable, low-confidence fallback, and reason text; local browser check verified the preview section and GPS decision display at http://127.0.0.1:5000/. Verified with npm run check:js, npm run test:unit, python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run test:e2e, npm run test:demo, and git diff --check.

userStories.title: Edit proposed place
userStories.description: As a user, I want to correct a photo's proposed place so that the final folder structure matches my intent.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview row provides an edit control for proposed place
Saving a place edit updates the output path immediately
Edited place is sanitized for folder output
Edited place persists after page reload
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: organization preview rows now include a proposed-place input and save control. Saving a place edit sanitizes the value with the same preview-safe path helper, updates the grouped folder immediately, marks the decision as manual, persists through the existing /pins save flow, and restores after reload. Browser e2e covers unsafe character sanitization, immediate folder update, manual decision display, persistence after restore, and returning the seed row to its original place. Verified with npm run check:js and npm run test:e2e.

userStories.title: Edit proposed date
userStories.description: As a user, I want to correct a photo's proposed date group so that photos appear under the right trip day.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview row provides an edit control for proposed date
Saving a date edit updates the output path immediately
Invalid or cleared date uses `Unknown Date`
Edited date persists after page reload
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: organization preview rows now include a proposed-date input and save control. Saving a valid date updates organization.candidateCaptureDate and the grouped output folder immediately, persists through /pins, and restores after reload. Clearing the date stores Unknown Date and moves the row to an Unknown Date folder. Browser e2e covers valid date edit, reload persistence, cleared-date fallback, and cleanup of the temporary row. Verified with npm run check:js and npm run test:e2e.

userStories.title: Edit proposed output filename
userStories.description: As a user, I want to correct a photo's proposed filename so that the exported files are named clearly.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview row provides an edit control for proposed filename
Saving a filename edit updates the output path immediately
Edited filename keeps the original extension unless the user explicitly includes one
Edited filename is sanitized and deduplicated within its output folder
Edited filename persists after page reload
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Completed: organization preview rows now include a proposed-filename input and save control. Saving a filename edit stores organization.candidateFilename, updates the preview filename immediately, keeps the original extension when the user omits one, preserves an explicitly typed extension, sanitizes backend output paths, and deduplicates filenames within the same output folder. Browser e2e covers extension preservation, duplicate suffixing, reload persistence, explicit extension edits, and cleanup. Backend tests cover candidateFilename path generation and safe outputPath persistence. Verified with npm run check:js, python -m unittest discover -s tests, and npm run test:e2e.

userStories.title: Create organized ZIP export endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want the server to produce a ZIP from the approved preview so that I can keep the cleaned library outside Pindrop.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend endpoint creates a ZIP using the current persisted organization preview
ZIP entries use output paths that exactly match the preview
ZIP includes photos with `Unknown Date` or `Unknown Location` paths
ZIP export fails gracefully when a stored upload is missing
Backend tests verify ZIP entry names for known and unknown folders
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: added GET /organization/export.zip. The endpoint loads the persisted organization preview, writes each stored upload to the ZIP using the exact preview outputPath, includes Unknown Date and Unknown Location folders, and returns a graceful 400 JSON response listing missing stored uploads. Backend tests cover preview path parity, unknown fallback paths, and missing upload errors. Verified with python -m unittest discover -s tests, npm run check:js, and npm run test:e2e.

userStories.title: Add ZIP manifest
userStories.description: As a user, I want the ZIP to include a manifest so that I can audit how each photo was organized.
acceptanceCriteria: ZIP contains `manifest.json` at the archive root
Manifest includes original filename, stored filename, output path, date, place, confidence, and reason for each exported photo
Manifest includes fallback values for unknown date and unknown location
Backend tests parse manifest and verify required fields
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: ZIP export now writes manifest.json at the archive root. The manifest includes originalFilename, storedFilename, outputPath, date, place, confidence, and reason for every exported photo, including Unknown Date and Unknown Location fallback values. Backend tests parse manifest.json and verify required fields. Verified with python -m unittest discover -s tests.

userStories.title: Verify ZIP byte preservation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want automated proof that ZIP export preserves original image bytes so that export cannot reduce photo quality.
acceptanceCriteria: ZIP export code adds stored upload bytes directly without image resizing, decoding/re-encoding, format conversion, or EXIF stripping
Automated test computes SHA-256 for at least one stored source upload
Automated test computes SHA-256 for the corresponding ZIP entry
Test asserts the source upload hash equals the ZIP entry hash
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: ZIP export writes stored upload bytes directly with ZipFile.writestr and does not resize, decode/re-encode, convert formats, or strip EXIF. Added an automated SHA-256 test comparing source upload bytes with the corresponding ZIP entry bytes. Verified with python -m unittest discover -s tests.

userStories.title: Add organized ZIP export UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download the organized ZIP from the preview screen so that the workflow has a clear final output.
acceptanceCriteria: UI exposes a ZIP export action near the organization preview
Export action is disabled when there are no valid source photos
Clicking export downloads the ZIP returned by the backend endpoint

userStories.notes: Completed: added a ZIP download button beside the organization preview and converted the header export action to organized ZIP export. Export controls are disabled when no source photos are available, successful clicks download the backend ZIP response, and backend errors show a visible toast. Browser e2e covers ZIP download start, suggested filename, error toast, and disabled empty-state export controls. Verified with npm run check:js and npm run test:e2e.

userStories.title: Add original move confirmation UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want original file movement to require explicit confirmation so that Pindrop never destructively changes my library by accident.
acceptanceCriteria: Original move action is separate from ZIP export
UI explains that moving originals changes files outside Pindrop

Move action is disabled when browser/session cannot access original file paths

userStories.notes: Completed: original file movement is separate from ZIP export. The organization panel now shows a disabled original-move action with safety copy explaining that moving originals changes files outside Pindrop and requires source-path access plus destination confirmation. The action remains disabled in the browser session because the web app does not have reliable original file path or file-handle access. Browser e2e verifies the disabled control and safety copy.

userStories.title: Add safe original move service contract
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a guarded service contract for moving originals so that future supported-access implementations cannot overwrite or partially corrupt a library.
acceptanceCriteria: Move service requires explicit source path or file-handle access data before it can run
Move service validates every source exists before moving anything
Move service refuses to overwrite destination files
Move service returns per-file status for missing source, duplicate destination, and success
Tests cover unsupported access, missing source, duplicate destination, and success path where feasible
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed: added a guarded move_originals service contract. It requires explicit sourcePath and destinationPath access data plus confirmation, validates all sources and destinations before moving anything, refuses existing or duplicate destinations, and returns per-file statuses for unsupported access, missing source, duplicate destination, blocked, and success. Backend tests cover unsupported access, missing source without partial moves, duplicate destination refusal, and a confirmed success path.

acceptanceCriteria: Map preview is visually secondary to import, organization preview, and export controls

userStories.notes: Completed: map remains a supporting preview. The UI labels it as 지도 미리보기, keeps import/organization preview/export controls in the primary sidebar workflow, shows GPS-backed photos on the map, keeps GPS-missing photos in the organization preview, and does not require map interaction for ZIP export. Browser e2e covers the map preview label, GPS map pins, GPS-missing organization rows, and ZIP export without depending on a map action.

acceptanceCriteria: Demo includes at least one GPS-backed photo

Demo includes at least one GPS-missing photo that falls back to `Unknown Location`

userStories.notes: Completed: added mixed-photo organization demo coverage.
